title: Shaft diameters against a tolerance
intro: A lathe turns shafts with diameters normal with mean μ = 25.00 mm and standard deviation σ = 0.02 mm. The drawing allows 25.00 ± 0.03 mm, so a shaft is in tolerance between 24.97 and 25.03 mm. z for 24.97 is (24.97 − 25.00)/0.02 = −1.5; P(X ≤ 24.97) = Φ(−1.5) = 0.0668, and the shaded area, the share in tolerance, is 0.8664. The quantile for q = 0.99 is the diameter that 99 % of shafts are below.
